description: Spec: Person.self_profile_changeset casts fullname only and recalculates completeness, People.update_self_profile persists; PersonChannel.weight_changeset casts only weight using shared validation; People.update_self_channel_weight scopes literal channel id/person before read, no activity/identity/metadata changes; stable weight,id ordering.
